Dynamic stretching: 
1. arm circles (both directions)
2. scissor stretch 
3. zipper stretch
4. horizontal tricep stretch 
5. overhead tricep stretch 

for full routine use BEND app routines

Complete before workout: 
1. leg swings (front to back)
2. leg swings (side to side) 
3. knee grab 
4. toe touch (with bounce)
5. lateral lunges

for full routine use BEND app routine

first set should be light and a warm up. 

increase weight each set to increase RPE

6 each side per set

i use EZ bar for this instead of dumbbells. use what is more comfortable

if more difficulty is needed increase weight or superset with reverse lunges

1. Lateral line stretch 
2. Childs pose 
3. Overhead tricep stretch 
4. Arm circles 
5. Shoulder rolls 

for full routine use BEND app routine
8 each side
